rules.description: ADMIN HOME-IP ONLY (owner 04.10.2026): production /admin + /api/admin + /api/billing/admin; update the IP via .devtools/infra/allow-my-ip.sh
rules.expression: (http.host in {"affiliate-registry.com" "www.affiliate-registry.com"}) and (http.request.uri.path in {"/admin" "/en/admin" "/es/admin" "/pt/admin" "/fr/admin" "/de/admin" "/it/admin" "/nl/admin" "/pl/admin" "/cs/admin" "/ru/admin" "/uk/admin" "/tr/admin" "/ar/admin" "/hi/admin" "/id/admin" "/vi/admin" "/th/admin" "/ja/admin" "/ko/admin" "/zh/admin" "/admin/" "/en/admin/" "/es/admin/" "/pt/admin/" "/fr/admin/" "/de/admin/" "/it/admin/" "/nl/admin/" "/pl/admin/" "/cs/admin/" "/ru/admin/" "/uk/admin/" "/tr/admin/" "/ar/admin/" "/hi/admin/" "/id/admin/" "/vi/admin/" "/th/admin/" "/ja/admin/" "/ko/admin/" "/zh/admin/"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/admin") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/billing/admin")) and not ip.src in {91.197.68.7}
http.request.headers["x-e2e-bypass"][0] eq "<REDACTED — live value is in the Coolify env, not in git>"

rules.description: STAGE OWNER-ONLY (04.10.2026): stage. answers the owner's IP, the gate (skip header above) and the provider webhook; update the IP via .devtools/infra/allow-my-ip.sh
rules.expression: (http.host eq "stage.affiliate-registry.com") and not ip.src in {91.197.68.7} and http.request.uri.path ne "/api/billing/webhook"

rules.description: block SEO/backlink crawlers, tool UAs and empty UA — HOME ONLY. AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, PetalBot, Bytespider) unblocked 31.08.2026 by owner; search engines were never blocked.
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/" or http.request.uri.path in {"/en" "/es" "/pt" "/fr" "/de" "/it" "/nl" "/pl" "/cs" "/ru" "/uk" "/tr" "/ar" "/hi" "/id" "/vi" "/th" "/ja" "/ko" "/zh"}) and ((lower(http.user_agent) contains "ahrefs" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "semrush" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "mj12bot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "dotbot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "rogerbot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "dataforseo" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "serpstat" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "seokicks" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "blexbot") or (not cf.client.bot and (http.user_agent eq "" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "python-requests" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "python-urllib" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "aiohttp" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "httpx" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "scrapy" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "curl/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "wget/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "go-http-client" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "java/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "okhttp" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "libwww-perl" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "node-fetch" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "axios/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "undici" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "httpclient" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "phantomjs" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "selenium" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "puppeteer" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "playwright")))

rules.description: challenge headless browsers, page loads without Accept-Language, and self-declared crawlers not Cloudflare-verified — HOME ONLY (owner rule 29.08.2026; merged 04.10.2026 to free a slot, free plan = 5 rules)
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/" or http.request.uri.path in {"/en" "/es" "/pt" "/fr" "/de" "/it" "/nl" "/pl" "/cs" "/ru" "/uk" "/tr" "/ar" "/hi" "/id" "/vi" "/th" "/ja" "/ko" "/zh"}) and ((not cf.client.bot and http.user_agent contains "Headless") or (not cf.client.bot and http.request.headers["sec-fetch-mode"][0] eq "navigate" and not any(http.request.headers["accept-language"][*] ne "")) or (not cf.client.bot and (lower(http.user_agent) contains "bot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "crawler" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "spider" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "scraper" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "scan")))
